# Linuxbrew (Homebrew on Linux) support for NixOS hosts.
#
# Homebrew ships FHS assumptions NixOS does not satisfy out of the box:
#   - bin/brew starts with `#!/bin/bash -pu`
#   - bottles and the vendored portable Ruby link against
#     /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
# envfs supplies /bin and /usr/bin (resolved from the caller's PATH) and nix-ld
# supplies the glibc loader plus a library search path. The prefix is created
# user-owned so `brew` itself never needs sudo.
#
# Opt-in per host: add `(import ../../hosts/nixos/linuxbrew.nix { inherit username; })`
# to the host's `modules` list.
{ username }:
{ pkgs, lib, ... }:
{
  # /bin/bash, /usr/bin/env, ... for Homebrew's scripts and any bottle wrapper.
  services.envfs.enable = true;
  services.envfs.extraFallbackPathCommands = ''
    ln -s ${pkgs.bash}/bin/bash $out/bash
  '';

  # Dynamic loader for prebuilt bottles and portable-ruby.
  programs.nix-ld.enable = lib.mkDefault true;
  programs.nix-ld.libraries = with pkgs; [
    curl
    glibc
    libgcc
    libxcrypt-legacy # portable-ruby needs libcrypt.so.1
    ncurses
    openssl
    zlib
  ];

  # Homebrew's Linux prefix must exist and be writable before `brew` runs.
  systemd.tmpfiles.rules = [
    "d /home/linuxbrew 0755 ${username} users -"
    "d /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew 0755 ${username} users -"
  ];

  # Build tools Homebrew expects from the system (docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-on-Linux).
  environment.systemPackages = with pkgs; [
    curl
    file
    gcc
    git
    gnumake
    procps
  ];
}

# Install Homebrew into the Linuxbrew prefix if it is not there yet.
#
# Uses the git-clone install method instead of install.sh: the prefix is already
# created user-owned by systemd-tmpfiles, so no sudo and no /usr writes needed.

# Usage: install-linuxbrew.sh <prefix> <git-binary>
set -euo pipefail

PREFIX="${1:?prefix required}"
GIT="${2:-git}"

REPO="$PREFIX/Homebrew"
BREW="$PREFIX/bin/brew"

if [ -x "$BREW" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

if [ ! -d "$PREFIX" ]; then
  echo "linuxbrew: $PREFIX does not exist; is the linuxbrew NixOS module enabled?" >&2
  exit 0
fi

if [ ! -w "$PREFIX" ]; then
  echo "linuxbrew: $PREFIX is not writable by $(id -un)" >&2
  exit 0
fi

if [ ! -d "$REPO/.git" ]; then
  echo "linuxbrew: cloning Homebrew into $REPO"
  "$GIT" clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Homebrew/brew "$REPO"
fi

mkdir -p "$PREFIX/bin"
ln -sfn ../Homebrew/bin/brew "$BREW"

echo "linuxbrew: installed $BREW"

Wired linuxbrew into the NixOS side of the repo. Changes:

**New: [hosts/nixos/linuxbrew.nix](hosts/nixos/linuxbrew.nix)** - opt-in NixOS module (takes `username`):
- `services.envfs.enable` - supplies `/bin/bash` (brew's shebang is `#!/bin/bash -pu`) and `/usr/bin/*`, with `${pkgs.bash}/bin/bash` in the fallback path
- `programs.nix-ld` + libs (glibc, libgcc, libxcrypt-legacy, zlib, ncurses, openssl, curl) - provides `/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2` for bottles and portable-ruby
- `systemd.tmpfiles.rules` creating `/home/linuxbrew` and `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew` user-owned, so brew never needs sudo
- system build deps per the Homebrew-on-Linux docs: curl, file, gcc, git, gnumake, procps

**New: [home-manager/activation/install-linuxbrew.sh](home-manager/activation/install-linuxbrew.sh)** - idempotent git-clone install (`git clone --depth=1 Homebrew/brew` + relative symlink `bin/brew`), skipping `install.sh` entirely since the prefix is already user-owned. Warns and exits 0 when the prefix is missing or unwritable, so activation never breaks.

**[named-hosts/matic/default.nix](named-hosts/matic/default.nix)** - imports the module and runs the installer via `home.activation.installLinuxbrew` (delegated-bash form, passes `scripts/check-nix-inline-scripts.sh`).

**Shell integration** - `brew shellenv` eval guarded by file existence in [fish](home-manager/programs/fish/default.nix) (login + interactive) and [zsh](home-manager/programs/zsh/default.nix) `envExtra`, plus `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin` in the PATH blocks of fish/zsh/[bash](home-manager/programs/bash/default.nix), next to the existing `/opt/homebrew` entries. No-ops on darwin.

**New: [spec/install_linuxbrew_spec.sh](spec/install_linuxbrew_spec.sh)** - 5 examples, passing.

Verification:
- `nix fmt` on all touched files: 0 changed
- `scripts/check-nix-inline-scripts.sh`: clean
- Module evaluated standalone against the pinned nixpkgs: `envfs = true`, `nix-ld = true`, tmpfiles rules present, `/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 -> nix-ld` in the ruleset
- Full `.#nixosConfigurations.matic` eval is not possible from darwin (IFD hits an x86_64-linux `docker.service.drv`) - matches the existing "can't be validated in darwin CI" note in [flake.nix:68](flake.nix:68). Needs an on-device rebuild.

On matic:

```bash
make switch
```

Then `brew --version`. Only matic opts in; add the same module line to viper/kyber if you want it there.
